tools.name: request_client_consent
tools.description: Sends a confirmation email to the client with the exact proposed online consultation details, booking rules and privacy notice. The client must open the link, review the details and personally confirm consent. This tool does not reserve a slot or initiate payment. Collect no clinical history.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Creates a temporary booking hold and Stripe Checkout session; it does NOT confirm an appointment. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_agent_booking_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_client_consent, get_agent_booking_status · Private data: create_checkout_session, get_agent_booking_status · Public sink: request_client_consent, create_checkout_session, get_agent_booking_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_client_consent, get_agent_booking_status · Private data: create_checkout_session, get_agent_booking_status · Public sink: request_client_consent, create_checkout_session, get_agent_booking_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
